config.unstablenickhider.title: Simple Unstable Nick Hider
config.unstablenickhider.option.enable.d: Turns the nick hider on or off.
config.unstablenickhider.option.random_m: Picks a random nickname from the predetermined Unstable Events player list (defined in the mod itself).
config.unstablenickhider.option.server_n: The specific nickname to show when random mode is off.
config.unstablenickhider.option.automati: Automatically changes your skin locally to match your current nickname. If the nickname is not a real player, you get a Default skin.
config.unstablenickhider.option.hide_ski: Always shows a default skin instead of yours. Overrides Automatic Skin.
config.unstablenickhider.option.disable_: Disables ALL rendering of player nametags. Players on the Render Whitelist are not affected.
Disables ALL rendering of players (body, nametag, everything). Players on the Render Whitelist are not affected.
config.unstablenickhider.option.render_w: Comma-separated list of real player usernames that are NOT affected by the render settings above. Example: Wemmbu, FlameFrags
config.unstablenickhider.option.ranks_wh: Comma-separated list of ranks (e.g. LuckPerms groups). Players with these ranks are NOT affected by the render settings. Matching is case-insensitive and ignores colours, bold and italic styling. Example: OP, Assistant, Trusted
config.unstablenickhider.option.teams_wh: Comma-separated list of scoreboard team names. Players on these teams are NOT affected by the render settings. Matching is case-insensitive. Example: RED, BLUE
config.unstablenickhider.option.other_ra: Gives every player a default skin. Whitelisted players keep their real skin.
Locks every player's head to a random look direction that stays fixed even while they move. Whitelisted players are not affected.
config.unstablenickhider.option.hide_fro: Locally hides you from the player tab list, even while nicked, Only you see this change.
